name: -16 AN 30 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End Fitting
title: -16 AN 30 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End Fitting
description:
The -16 AN 30 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End Fitting is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings Standard AN Hose Ends are precision-engineered for high-pressure fuel, oil, coolant, brake, clutch, and power steering applications. Designed for use with nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these AN fittings provide a secure, leak-free 37-degree flare seal for street performance, racing, marine, and motorsport plumbing systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
• Flow Configuration: 30° mandrel-bent profile for high velocity in tight engine bays.
